news.title: Gemini brings personalized assistance into the car
news.summary: Google is rolling out optional Personal Intelligence for Android Auto, letting Gemini use connected Google apps for more contextual help. Support for cars with Google built-in is planned for the coming months.

news.title: AI moves from the screen to factories and vehicles
news.summary: AP reports on NVIDIA’s European partnerships with manufacturers including Siemens and Mercedes-Benz, showing how companies are applying AI to physical systems and automated driving. These partnerships span current work and future plans.

news.title: Albertsons expands AI for shoppers and employees
news.summary: Albertsons is expanding its OpenAI partnership across customer experiences and internal work. The company’s announcement describes retail innovation and grocery shopping through ChatGPT.

repos.name: n8n Workflow Collection
repos.description: A community collection of n8n workflow JSON files. Explore automations and adapt the integrations to your own projects.
repos.useCase: Find reusable workflow patterns, then import a selected JSON into n8n and configure its connections.

repos.name: OpenAI Cookbook
repos.description: Practical code examples and guides for building with the OpenAI API, primarily in Python.
repos.useCase: Start from an example notebook for an AI application and adapt it to your data and API access.

repos.name: Claude Cookbooks
repos.description: Recipes and notebooks that demonstrate practical ways to build applications with Claude, including tool use.
repos.useCase: Explore tool-calling examples and adapt a recipe for your own Claude-powered workflow.

repos.name: AI Agents for Beginners
repos.description: An educational collection of lessons and sample code for learning how to build AI agents.
repos.useCase: Work through agent concepts and hands-on examples before adapting them to a project.
